description: U.S. National Transportation Atlas Highways is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Bureau of Transportation Statistics, Harvard Geospatial Library. U.S. National Transportation Atlas Highways represents rural interstates and arteries; and urban freeways, expressways, interstates, arteries and collectors. U.S. National Transportation Atlas Highways is part of the National Highway Planning Network version 2.1 published by the Bureau of Transportation Statistics as part of the National Transportation Atlas Databases for the United States. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2011. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is terms recorded on the dataset page: The data are provided under the Harvard University Site License. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
